```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE)
## target knits qmds in their own session, so load libraries here.
source(here::here("packages.R"))
tar_source() # not always necessary
```

```{r}
#| label: load-targets
#| include: false
with_dir(here(), {
  tar_load(patch_id_raster)
  tar_load(connectivity)
  tar_load(interpatch_distance)
  tar_load(species)
  tar_load(barrier_plots)
})
```

<!-- TODO for mdsumner - can we get a buffer/outline of the city boundaries -->

## Habitat, Buffered Habitat, and Barrier

```{r}
#| label: plot-barrier-habitat-buffer
#| panel: tabset
#| output: asis

# the pipeline writes these next to this document
basename(barrier_plots) |>
  setNames(interpatch_distance) |>
  show_image_tabs("Interpatch distance:")
```

## Patch ID

```{r}
#| label: plot-patches
#| panel: tabset
#| output: asis

patch_plots <- map2(
  .x = patch_id_raster,
  .y = interpatch_distance,
  .f = \(x, y) {
    plot_patches(patch_id = x, interpatch_distance = y, species = species)
  }
  ) |>
  setNames(interpatch_distance)

show_tabs(patch_plots, message = "Interpatch distance:")
```

# Area and patch information for each interpatch distance

```{r}
#| label: display-areas

summary_dts <- connectivity |>
  dplyr::select(interpatch_distance, patch_size) |>
  unnest(patch_size) |>
  datatable()

summary_dts
```

## Prob connectedness and summary information for each interpatch distance

```{r}
connectivity |> connectivity_display() |> round_by() |> datatable()
```

## Longer: Prob connectedness and summary information for each interpatch distance

```{r}
connectivity |>
  dplyr::select(-data_resolution, -patch_size) |>
pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(species,
              interpatch_distance)
  ) |>
  datatable(
    options = list(
      pageLength = 8L
    )
  )
```

## Visualisation of changes in key stats over interpatch distance

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
plot_connectivity(connectivity)
```


## Running time

It is useful to understand how long the pipeline takes, let's take a look at the timing of some key targets

```{r}
#| label: running-time
target_timings <- tar_meta() |> dplyr::select(name, bytes, seconds)

target_timings |>
  drop_na() |>
  arrange(desc(seconds)) |>
  mutate(
    bytes_pretty = pretty_bytes(bytes),
    .after = bytes
  ) |>
  rename(
    target_name = name,
    runtime_seconds = seconds
  ) |>
  datatable()
```
